analogy.rationale: Bacterial DNA inhibitors target prokaryotic DNA replication machinery that human cells lack, so they should produce little transcriptional response; the closest analogs are other bacterial DNA-targeting classes, with weaker similarity to human DNA synthesis/topoisomerase inhibitors that could cause off-target DNA damage responses.
